common.nothingToShow: Nothing to show in the {{view}} view.
traffic.title: Traffic
explain.progressing: Not ready yet: Knative is still rolling out the latest revision or its route.
explain.revisionFailedTrafficStays: The latest revision {{revision}} failed ({{reason}}). Traffic stays on {{ready}}, the last revision that became ready.
explain.revisionFailedNoneReady: The latest revision {{revision}} failed ({{reason}}), and no revision has become ready yet: nothing serves requests.
explain.routeFailed: The route is not ready ({{reason}}): requests may not reach the revisions as the traffic split asks.
explain.domainNotClaimed: The domain name is not claimed ({{reason}}): another mapping may already use it.
explain.certificateFailed: The TLS certificate could not be provisioned ({{reason}}).
explain.revisionScaledToZero: Ready, and scaled to zero: no traffic reaches it now, so no Pods run. The first request starts one.
explain.revisionProgressing: Starting: the revision's Pods are not ready yet.
explain.revisionContainerUnhealthy: The container does not start or fails its health checks ({{reason}}).
explain.revisionResourcesUnavailable: Knative could not get the resources the revision needs ({{reason}}), for example its image or its Pods.
eventing.fields.subject: Subject
eventing.filter.legacyIgnored: spec.filter is ignored: spec.filters is set and takes its place.
eventing.path.title: Event path
eventing.path.loading: Reading the objects on the path…
eventing.path.noSources: No source in this namespace sends events here.
eventing.path.noTriggers: No Trigger takes events from this Broker.
eventing.path.noSubscriptions: No Subscription takes events from this channel.
eventing.explain.progressing: Not ready yet: Knative is still setting it up.
eventing.explain.bindingReady: Ready: the sink address {{uri}} is injected into its subject.
eventing.explain.brokerIngress: The broker's ingress is not ready ({{reason}}): events sent to the broker are not accepted.
eventing.explain.brokerFilter: The broker's filter is not ready ({{reason}}): events do not reach its Triggers.
eventing.explain.brokerChannel: The channel behind the broker is not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.notAddressable: It has no address yet ({{reason}}): nothing can send events to it.
eventing.explain.deadLetterUnresolved: Its dead letter sink cannot be resolved ({{reason}}): the object it names may not exist or have no address.
eventing.explain.oidc: Its OIDC identity is not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.triggerBroker: Its Broker {{broker}} is not ready or does not exist ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.subscriberUnresolved: Its subscriber {{subscriber}} cannot be resolved to an address ({{reason}}): the object may not exist or have no URL.
eventing.explain.triggerSubscription: The subscription that delivers its events is not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.dependency: The source it depends on is not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.backingChannel: The channel implementation behind it is not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.imcDispatcher: The in-memory channel dispatcher is not ready ({{reason}}): check the imc-dispatcher in the knative-eventing namespace.
eventing.explain.subscriptionReferences: Its channel, subscriber, reply or dead letter sink cannot be resolved ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.notAddedToChannel: The channel has not taken the subscription yet ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.subscriptionChannel: Its channel {{channel}} does not report the subscription as ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.flowChannels: Some of its channels are not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.flowSubscriptions: Some of its subscriptions are not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.sinkUnresolved: Its sink {{sink}} cannot be resolved to an address ({{reason}}): the object may not exist or have no URL.
eventing.explain.adapterNotReady: The adapter that sends its events is not running ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.permissions: Its service account may not get, list and watch the resources it reads ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.containerBinding: The SinkBinding it made is not ready ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.bindingUnavailable: The sink cannot be injected into its subject ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.trustBundle: The CA trust bundles were not copied into its namespace ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.kafkaOffsets: The initial offsets of its consumer group were not committed ({{reason}}).
eventing.explain.kafkaKeyType: Its key type is not supported ({{reason}}).
